summary: FASE 11 RBAC Testing Complete: POST /api/users and POST /api/roles endpoints correctly protected with RBAC permissions. All 15 tests passed. SuperAdmin and Administrador (legacy fallback) can create users/roles. Usuario correctly denied (403). No auth correctly denied (403). POST /auth/register remains public. GET endpoints (FASE 9) no regression.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/users correctly uses verificar_permiso_rbac() with SISTEMA_USUARIOS_CREAR permission
POST /api/roles correctly uses verificar_permiso_rbac() with SISTEMA_ROLES_CREAR permission
Legacy fallback (role_level >= 3) works correctly for Administrador without explicit RBAC
POST /auth/register remains public (no RBAC modification) - requires 'role' field in payload
rbac_helper.py whitelist correctly includes SISTEMA_USUARIOS_CREAR and SISTEMA_ROLES_CREAR
Frontend Usuarios.js has matching RBAC_PERMISOS_PILOTO whitelist
test_credentials: REDACTED: plaintext credentials are not stored in repository reports. Tests must obtain credentials from fixtures or the authorized runtime environment.
seed_data_creation: Test users created during tests are cleaned up automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: FASE 11 RBAC POST endpoints fully tested. Key findings: 1) POST /api/users protected with SISTEMA_USUARIOS_CREAR permission + legacy fallback. 2) POST /api/roles protected with SISTEMA_ROLES_CREAR permission + legacy fallback. 3) Usuario role correctly denied (403). 4) No auth correctly denied (403). 5) POST /auth/register remains public but requires 'role' field. 6) GET /api/users and GET /api/roles (FASE 9) no regression. Credentials must come from authorized fixtures/environment.
